title: 60-minute live format
question: What format do we use for the lives?
actual: 41% attendance, below expected. Most drop-offs happen after minute 35.

frame.problem: We needed one standard format for every live, so hosting and promotion stop being reinvented each time. Which format do we use?

vars.name: Attendance
vars.ctx: Attendance drives the sales calls booked after the live.

vars.name: Depth of Q&A
vars.ctx: Questions are where objections surface and get answered.

vars.name: Host effort
vars.ctx: Every live is prepared and hosted by the same small team.

opts.name: 30 minutes
opts.desc: Short and dense, Q&A by email afterwards.

opts.name: 45 minutes and a replay
opts.desc: 30 min content, 15 min Q&A, replay sent the same day.
